## Problem

What the current files cannot do, or which two files disagree. Link the path (`SKILL.md`, `scripts/extract_mobi.py`, a `write-like-*` file).

## Change you want

The smallest change that would close the gap. Say which layout it targets:

- [ ] Parent skill (`01-world-and-material.md` … `06-generation-and-validation.md`)
- [ ] An existing child (`01-author-spirit.md` … `06-generation-editor.md`)
- [ ] An extractor in `scripts/`
- [ ] Docs only

## What you already checked

Confirm this is not already specified and simply undocumented. The four-genre specialization described in the old README is not in `SKILL.md`.

## Out of scope

This project is MIT (see `LICENSE`). Do not propose a different license here. Full copyrighted books and DRM-removal steps are out of scope.
